lookup: nearest-level BFS over extends links; level0 = direct methods; first level with candidates wins and stops; visited-set + depth bound 64 (cycles terminate, no panic)
private: DeclarationFlag::Private/Protected added (SCHEMA_VERSION 5); private reachable only when call scope is the same class at level 0
parent_colon: parent::m -> parents of lexical class, nearest-level walk from each; new parent -> parent decl candidates (no __construct claim); `parent` type hint binds through the same link
self: self -> lexical class; $this -> lexical class; same hierarchy walk
typed: receiver-type class candidates -> same hierarchy walk; typed rule kept at depth 0, inherited rule above
